hook: Water Board fines *Paradise* restaurant ₹20,000 for misusing drinking water
tldr: HMWS&SB fined Paradise restaurant, Secunderabad, ₹20,000 for misusing drinking water after an inspection by Division-16, Khairatabad Zone. The Board says it will keep acting against violators as the city faces a supply crunch.

beats.what: ₹20,000 fine on Paradise's water connection after an inspection.
beats.why: Hyderabad is short on water this season; the Board is cracking down on waste, from tankers to restaurants.
beats.care: Washing cars or floors with drinking water can get you fined too. Report waste to the Water Board (155313).

sources.name: The Hindu
